title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify the correct answer as (b).

title: Understanding of Lamb Shift
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the significance of the Lamb shift in relation to energy levels.

title: Cause of Lamb Shift
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention vacuum fluctuations of the electromagnetic field as the cause of the Lamb shift.

title: Mention of Thomas Precession
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss Thomas precession and its relevance to the Lamb shift.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrectly stating that the Lamb shift is caused by Thomas precession.
